name: Strawberry Roll-Up 2G MKX Disposable *LIMITED EDITION* - Sativa (Copy)
description: Strawberry Roll-Up delivers a sweet, candy-inspired burst of ripe strawberry flavor with nostalgic notes that bring you back to your favorite childhood treat. This indica-leaning strain pairs its smooth, sugary profile with relaxing yet engaging effects, creating a euphoric experience that's perfect for unwinding while staying present in the moment. Sweet, satisfying, and full of flavor, Strawberry Roll-Up is a delicious way to end the day.
